simple.meaning: חֶזְקָה (chezqâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “prevailing power.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.full: H2393. chezqah [ חֶזְקָה ] noun feminine strength, force (strictly Infinitive form from חזק see Ges § 45 . 1 b) — 1 of urgency of ׳י s hand in prophetic inspiration הַיָד֑ בְּחֶזְקַת Isa 8:11 (compare חָזַק Ezek 3:14 ). 2 of royal power כְּחֶזְקָתוֺ 2Chr 12:1 ; 26:16 (|| חָזַק 26:15 ), Dan 11:2 .

occurrences.englishText: When the kingdom of Rehoboam was established and he was strong, he abandoned Yahweh’s law, and all Israel with him.
But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up, so that he did corruptly, and he trespassed against Yahweh his God; for he went into Yahweh’s temple to burn incense on the altar of incense.
For Yahweh spoke this to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,

“Now I will show you the truth. Behold, three more kings will stand up in Persia; and the fourth will be far richer than all of them. When he has grown strong through his riches, he will stir up all against the realm of Greece.
